issues.evidence: rescore execute iterates over every saved case and reads case['result_path'] and case['result_sha256']. score_v3 creates cases with status='reference_infrastructure_unresolved' (label status != 'complete') that have neither key. The rescore would raise KeyError, or would silently need to drop those cases, so they are not carried forward as unresolved.
issues.required_action: Carry non-graded saved cases through unchanged as unresolved with an explicit status. Only cases with status 'graded' should be rescored. Count the carried cases in the unresolved totals.

issues.evidence: The rescore verifies candidate.sv equality, result.json against the stored sha, and the raw log against the stored sha. It does not compare result['rows_sha256'] with the current label's rows.json, or check that label['cycles'] equals result['attempted_cycles']. The adjudication computes the end/marker position from label['cycles'], while replay places the marker at len(rows)-1. A mismatch would misclassify marker versus ordinary alarms silently.
issues.required_action: In both the rescore and score_v3, assert that rows_sha256 matches the label's rows.json and that label['cycles'] == result['attempted_cycles'] == len(rows) before adjudicating. If either check fails, mark the case unresolved.

issues.evidence: score_v3 (the full grader) still reports observable_types as any oracle FAIL and has no per-type FAIL+unknown breakdown. The added unknown reporting exists only in rescore by_type, and even there the FAIL-with-unknown count is implicit (FAIL count minus fully_resolved_FAIL_pairs).
issues.required_action: Report FAIL_with_oracle_unknown_pairs per type explicitly in both paths, and label observable_types as 'oracle_FAIL_any_unknown_context'.

issues.evidence: In the rescore, unknown_pairs counts only oracle unknown records. Candidate unknown samples, incomplete replays and non-graded cases are omitted, unlike score_v3's unresolved_pairs. Separately, legacy fields from the old adjudicator (candidate_alarm_samples, first_alarm, early_safety_alarm_samples, physical_reference_PASS_alarm) still include marker alarms, alongside new fields that exclude them.
issues.required_action: Rename unknown_pairs to oracle_unknown_pairs or add a full unresolved count. Document which fields include the marker sample.

issues.evidence: In the category reports, the union definite_detected_types can include types credited only through an unattributed end alarm, for either finite category, on cases that are also safety-eligible.
issues.required_action: Report union types split by credit path (ordinary safety versus end-marker finite), or caveat the union as not category-attributed.

limitations: The witness reference never judges pre(S). A PASS or FAIL on the prefix through post(S-1) neither confirms nor refutes the selected alarm. A physical-prefix DUT FAIL and the reproduced alarm are separate facts.
A safety projection with trace_done=0 proves no 128-cycle completion and no end-only activation.
Oracle ld/lh suppression means only the first violation per channel is checked until reset.
An end alarm credits finite categories at case-eligibility level only; there is no slot or category attribution.
No candidate sources, outcomes, hidden rows or scores were reviewed. Any oracle change requires a separate Claude author.
review.scope: Recheck of adjudication v3, score v3, rescore v3 and witness v3 against the unchanged frozen-v2 oracle, using only this packet. All five prior findings are addressed in the adjudication and witness modules. (1) Safety credit now needs an ordinary, non-marker alarm at or after onset with no earlier alarm; marker_safety_signal and marker_only_safety_signal are reported separately. (2) input_completion now requires no alarm before the end sample, matching response_completion, and the shared end alarm is labelled UNATTRIBUTED_ANY_SLOT. (3) The witness labels PASS as reference_PASS_on_prefix_through_post_previous_cycle and sets candidate_false_alarm_claim=false. (4) reference_confirmed_selected_alarm=false and a FAIL is labelled unattributed to the selected alarm. (5) by_type in the rescore reports oracle_unknown_pairs and fully_resolved_FAIL_pairs. fully_resolved_detection is recomputed from the overridden definite flags. The oracle is unchanged and no actual oracle gap was found. The issues below are new adapter or reporting defects.
